'''Stone''' was a hard material. It had multiple applications, such as being used as a building material and to make weapons and household items.

==Description==
Stone was a hard, naturally occurring material that came in a variety of [[Color/Legends|colors]] including black,<ref name="DNI" /> dark brown,<ref name="Assault" /> dark gray,<ref name="Ambush" /> dark green, tan,<ref name="Globe" /> and white.<ref name="Ambush" />

While a hard material, stone could be cut through with devices such as a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].<ref name="Assault" /> In addition to being naturally-occurring, synthetic stone was also known to exist.<ref name="DNI">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

Referring to a civilization as "stone level" was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] classification to describe the technology level of a planet. Stone level civilizations had a loosely-knit culture and basic social structure, used stone tools and had developed primitive agriculture.<ref name="PC" />

==Uses==
Stone was a building material often used by primitive [[Species/Legends|species]] to construct buildings.<ref name="Godking" /> Stone was also used in the construction of household items including vases and crocks,<ref name="DNI" /> artwork like statues,<ref name="Swarm">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Swarm]]''</ref> ornamentation such as [[Gargoyle/Legends|gargoyles]],<ref name="Lost Ones">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref> and as tombstones.<ref name="Assault" /> Stone was also used by more advanced civilizations, where varieties of stone were considered luxury items, such as marbled stone.<ref name="Kella" />

Stone could also be used to create tools<ref name="PC" /> and weapons. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] made stone arrowheads to affix to their [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]].<ref name="RotJRadio" /> The [[Lizard Warrior]]s from Endor topped their [[Spear/Legends|spears]] with stone heads.<ref name="Ewoks 4">[[Ewoks (1985) 4|''Ewoks'' (1985) 4]]</ref>

==History==
Black polished stone was used to construct the [[thal]]s, shrines that were central to the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Sant|religion]]. One stood in the center of every urban area and clan-[[City/Legends|city]] on the Weequay [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]].<ref name="GG12" />

The original inhabitants of the planet [[Simocadia]] built immense stone giants known as the [[Ardana Shadex]]. The species used the colossi to wage war across the planet. At some point, the creators of the giants disappeared, and the colossi went into hiding underground.<ref name="Colossus" />

The [[Null (species)|Nulls]], native to the planet [[Null/Legends|Null]], were considered to be master stonemasons. They constructed buildings using jagged stone from the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and fitted together in patterns with no need to use mortar or joinery. The building technique was a native artform, and removing one stone, known as a "keystone", would cause the entire building to collapse.<ref name="Legacy" />

The [[Jostran]]s native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Munlali Mafir]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] built [[City/Legends|cities]] out of stone. When the rogue planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] entered the planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and remained for three local [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the resulting [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] laid waste to the stone cities.<ref name="FHII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>

The [[Anointed People]] of [[Abonshee]] built one-and-two storey homes out of stone and [[Tree/Legends|wood]].<ref name="Godking" />

The planet [[Indu San/Legends|Indu San]] produced high-quality, luxury stone items as their primary economy. They were especially known for exquisitely-patterned [[Marble/Legends|marbled]] stone, as well as [[Granite/Legends|granite]] and [[serpentine]]. Stone featured prominently in Indu San architecture.<ref name="Kella" />

During the lead-up to the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] agitators began to stir up unrest against the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]. On the planet [[Dordolum]], [[Drend Navett]] instigated a riot by first throwing [[blicci]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] at a building owned by the [[Solferin Shipping Company]] before building up to using rough stones to break windows.<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

In the wake of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Reconstruction Authority]] moved the seat of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As part of the relocation, the Galactic Alliance gifted the [[New Jedi Order]] a stone-and-[[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[New Jedi Temple|temple]] design to harmonize with the new architecture of post-invasion Coruscant.<ref name="DNI" />

==Varieties==
Specific types of stone included [[larstone]],<ref name="DNI" /> [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]],<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> [[Velmstone/Legends|velmstone]],<ref name="Velmor">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030306velmor1|series=Velmor: Royalty and Rebellion|text=Part 1: A Diplomatic Report}}</ref> marble, granite, and serpentine.<ref name="Kella" />
